title: Prawn, leek and potato bake
summary: Prawn, leek and potato bake is a british dinner built around raw king prawns and leeks, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Prawn, leek and potato bake into even pieces and toss leeks with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of leeks while you season raw king prawns. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle raw king prawns and new potatoes among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Prawn, leek and potato bake before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Prawn, leek and potato bake into warm bowls with the juices.  Check that the potatoes is tender, then serve.
